cell_type.evidence: iPSCs were differentiated to neurons of cortical layers V and VI based on Shi et al., 2012 with minor modifications.
Human Embryoid Body (EB)-Based Hematopoietic Stem Cells (iH) Culturing and Maintenance
For neutrophilic differentiation, medium was changed on day 7 to fresh APEL medium supplemented with IL-3 (50 ng/ml) (BioLegend) and G-CSF (10 ng/ml) (Filgrastim Hexal).
Suspension cells were harvested and analyzed by flow cytometry on day 14 (CD34+ cells) and day 28 (neutrophils) as described before.

sample_source.evidence: Conditioned media from iN (iNCM) between days 27–40 and for iH (iHCM) at day 21 was collected and sequentially centrifuged at 4 °C at 250 × g for 5 min, 400 × g for 5 min and finally at 2,000 × g for 10 min to discard pellets containing loose cells, cell debris and apoptotic bodies.
